description: Read-only. The phone sign-up form of an app (provider yemot, Yemot HaMashiach): { ivrForm } with the board, greeting, steps, thanks and the optional caller phone and call id columns, or { ivrForm: null } when none is set. See set_telephony_ivr_form for what a form is. Needs the server to have phone forms on: a 404 means it is not enabled yet.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: get_telephony_ivr_form
